findings.title: Compare every received policy control before reporting convergence
findings.scenario: After a converged desktop render, change only quality.marschner or enabled shadow_resolution1024->2048. min_pixels, shadow representation, accumulate, scene generation and moving remain unchanged, so converged returns true even though render changes Globals.mode[0] or shadow map/texel and must redraw. A caller trusting convergence can keep stale shading. Changed band/blend selection is similarly absent from this predicate.
findings.proof: render evaluates policy at1669-1674; allocates shadow maps1699-ish; Globals.mode uses quality.marschner; RenderedView same test1801 does handle these if render is reached. converged fails earlier policy comparison.
findings.minimum_connected_repair: Retain/derive an effective policy identity sufficient for converged to compare all actual policy-dependent view/shading inputs, including selected representation/blend and active shadow/shading controls. Ignore ineffective fields such as shadow settings while disabled. Coordinate root still-open policy/empty-LOD admission; no arbitrary whole-policy prose/name comparison.
findings.classification: Actionable root-owned policy/shared-state gap in explicitly unfinished family; retained behavior/partial new repair, not a claim that family was complete.

findings.title: Reject render state that can never converge before queuing an unbounded loop
findings.scenario: Public Camera.eye containing NaN is admitted. It propagates into Globals (camera and view projection). RenderedView uses float PartialEq; NaN prevents self.last==Some(view) every frame, so render resets frames0 and returns frames1. With quality.accumulate>1, render_converged while frames<wanted never exits and continues queue submissions. The same mechanism applies nonfinite lighting/material/policy/derived state.
findings.proof: Public Camera fields at75-79, view Projection331-347; render state/cache at1665-1808 and frames increment2147; render_converged2166-2177. No runtime witness needed: NaN equality and reset/loop control flow establish it.
findings.minimum_connected_repair: Admit finite/valid render camera/shading/derived state before cache publication/submission, or return a typed nonprogress error instead of an unbounded convergence loop. Preserve all valid finite numerical shader behavior; canonical state/error owner belongs root open admission family.

contracts_revalidated: Full renderer production body reviewed: constructor layouts/shaders/pipelines/uniforms/samplers/deform module, atlas writes, shadows and lighting rebinding, host/GPU groom intake, level/card uploads, dynamics binding/rest copy/rebinding, simulated movement/clearing/deformation, head/cover, targets/resize, convergence/render/temporal mean/postprocess/primitives/headless constructor and all native helpers.

Per-level deformation: bind creates Pending for each level; set_moved marks every level Pending; record_deformations visits main, enabled shadow and blend levels, only consumes each pending state once. Hidden levels remain pending until later use; duplicate selected levels do not issue duplicate deform. Camera/policy level switches and blend/shadow re-entry therefore see outstanding update. Checked population/layout/deform addressing still required from canonical producers.

RenderedView newly includes min_pixels and effective shadow Representation; render compares Globals+representation+blend+effective shadow and scene generation. Disabled shadow selection is correctly excluded. R197-C1 remains specifically converged(policy), not a false claim that render itself omits changed Marschner/active-resolution Globals.

Frame count uses saturating increment and u64 frames+1 denominator; no u32 overflow in temporal mean. Resize clears last/frames/history so read_rgba rejects resized-but-unrendered output. Dynamics head transform deliberately excluded from still-view equality while moving forces rendering/temporal filtering; clear_dynamics/groom/head changes increment generation.

Output readback: private output texture is from resize with one layer/sample, nonzero clamped width/height and COPY_SRC. Four supported RGBA/BGRA unorm/sRGB formats classified; unsupported format rejected before GPU work. Checked row4*width and padded-row alignment; padded*height fits u64. Tightly packed image usize narrowing+try_reserve before map; from_raw checked shape; mapped rows exclude padding; BGRA swapsR/B after view drops. No fake absent frame after resize.

Native readback explicitly Waits for private-copy work then awaits actual mapping callback; browser uses canonical await_browser_callback driving nonblocking Poll plus zero-duration task timer. SDK WebGPU auto-progress/no-op Poll and WebGL provider progress are honored. Mapping/Poll/oneshot/image allocation errors retain actual sources through HairGpuError. Native renderer creation/copy/finish/submit still use documented device error handling; Ok mapping is no global/native observed-validation verdict.

Private staging cancellation/failure differs shared Buffer mapping: native CoreBuffer Drop invokes global.buffer_drop, which removes hub buffer and performs best-effort native unmap; failed state is not externally reusable. Pending native mapping gets abort cleanup on owned handle drop. Browser drops its private JS handle for provider/GC; SDK WebBuffer Drop has no explicit unmap. No demonstrated public alias poisoning or permanent leak is claimed; no invented duplicate guard requirement.

Canonical generic poll_callback<T>: ready value or closed receiver checked before device.poll, then one nonblocking Poll and second receive. No Clone/Default/Send bound added to arbitrary T. await_browser_callback calls it and yields through timer DurationZERO only while pending, actual Poll/Canceled sources retained. Channel belongs to exact device is documented precondition, not runtime proof.

Lower Buffer mapping and WorkCompletion browser consumers preserve original source chains via exhaustive From<CallbackProgressError>. Buffer native complete still performs explicit Wait before ready-first helper: helper itself does not poll already-delivered T, but caller is not promised to skip its explicit readback Wait. Browser shared MappingRequest cancellation guard survives timer await. WorkCompletion browser SDK callback still cannot expose underlying promise rejection and docs retain that limit.

New render feature includes optional futures-channel; gpu-only build does not require render-only channel import. HairGpuError old typed SDK sources remain and new RenderReadbackError/CallbackProgress conversion retains actual error values. Cargo.lock integration remains known owner dependency.

No current external HairRenderer runtime callers were found in source search beyond documentation; public API control-flow findings are representable library contracts, not claims about a present application failure.
